name: Levitate
description:
Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

Choose a creature or object within medium range weighing no more than twice your own weight. If unrestrained, it rises vertically, up to short range off the ground, and hovers there. Roll Lore to set the Difficulty. If the target is an unwilling creature, it may roll Fortitude against the Difficulty. On a pass, the spell ends.

If you are the target, you may cause yourself to move up to your Speed up or down as part of your normal movement. Otherwise, you may spend an action to move the target higher or lower, up to short range from where it was. If the target is a creature, it can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach.

If at any point the target becomes further than medium range from you, the spell ends. If the target is still levitating when the spell ends, it floats harmlessly to the ground.

Describe the levitation.
successes:
✨: The target may be as far as long range from you without causing the spell to end.

🌞: You may spend an action to move the target up to short range in any direction, not just up or down.

💀: Check a Condition. You become the target of the spell, you cannot cause yourself to move downward, and the effect lasts for the full 10 minutes regardless of concentration, or until you manage to get both your feet on solid ground.

improvements.name: Greater Levitation
improvements.description: You may target a creature or object up to four times your weight.
